zh: 冒烟架、临时宿主、脚本化模型、端到端通道与三个在线探针全部住进 `packages/testing/`，共用一套 Playwright 浏览器栈，`scripts/` 只剩构建与文档工具。
en: The smoke harness, the scratch host, the scripted model service, the end-to-end lane and the three live probes all live in `packages/testing/` on one Playwright stack, leaving `scripts/` with the build and document tools.
